notes: Defensive game plans: Base, Stack the box, Two-high coverage or Blitz heavy, graded against the opponent's scheme and quarterback (stack a run team and it pays; stack a passing team and they go over the top; blitz a shaky QB for chaos, blitz a great one at your peril). The last-result card now shows your full plan and whether it worked or hurt you. Named rivalries can come with a trophy (the Iron Skillet, the Old Oaken Bucket and friends) that changes hands with the series. Heisman ceremony: five finalists with vote shares on the Polls tab. School records: when one of your players passes a single-season school mark midseason, it hits the newswire the week it happens.
